Stored pages are the DOMESTIC view (the Domestic/International switch is a JavaScript menu); the Fees block (e.g. '2026: $8,344 plus $300 Student Services Fee per year') is the domestic fee, so there is no fee pattern. Intakes: dated list under the heading 'Locations and dates' (Campus: day Month year), up to Study options/Length. IELTS: first IELTS figure on the page (wording varies: 'IELTS 6.0 Academic', '(IELTS) overall academic score of at least 5.5', 'IELTS (General) score of 5'). Campus: Location block before Years. Mode: Study options. Duration: Length. study_level: NZQF level in the page heading. term_months from https://www.nmit.ac.nz/study/planning-your-studies/academic-dates (2026: S1 16 Feb, S2 20 Jul; 2027: S1 15 Feb, S2 19 Jul). Central English page: https://www.nmit.ac.nz/international/entry-requirements 5 Oct 15:22 (exit awards and requirements): entry_requirement reads the academic entry requirement under 'Entry requirements' (up to Alternative / English language requirements); it applies to all applicants, with international equivalents assessed by NMIT. No exit points are printed on the stored programme pages, so no exit_awards pattern. No fee_total: the stored pages are the domestic view and print only the domestic per-year fee.
